description: RQ-A: bit allocation in a fixed-length identifier as single-machine weighted completion time, solved by Smith's rule

e_a1_optimality.note: smithDepth is compared against the exact optimum over every permutation of the same instance; bruteForceAgreement is the fraction of instances where the allocator attains it

e_a2_entropy_locality_frontier.note: the tenant field is widened one bit at a time; structuredBits and randomBits sum to the 122-bit payload budget, and the collision probability is the exact upper bound for 2M ids at the residual width
